title: release-cutover-checklist-2026-03-07-mateo-scratchpad
content:
Brief: quick scratchpad for 2026-03-07 release cutover. Use this as my single-file TODO + comms template.

Timeline (PST):
- 08:00 - Final pre-cutover sync w/ SRE, Infra, QA (30m)
- 08:30 - Freeze PR merges to main (owner: Jordan)
- 08:45 - Start canary traffic routing changes (Aisha)
- 09:00 - Cutover window start: migrate DB schema v42 + backend deploys (Riley leads)
- 09:30 - Run smoke tests + basic e2e (QA)
- 10:00 - Ramp to 50% traffic, monitor (15m)
- 10:30 - Ramp to 100% if stable
- 11:00 - Post-cutover validations, update docs, close incident

Pre-cutover checklist (must be green before 09:00):
- [ ] Confirm on-call roster + escalation path (PagerDuty rota)
- [ ] Ensure backup snapshots taken (db01/db02) - ask SRE to confirm
- [ ] Merge blockers resolved (see blockers list below)
- [ ] Canary infra up-to-date on config (check infra/ansible PRs)
- [ ] Run smoke test locally against canary (qa: riley)
- [ ] Slack channel #release-cutover ready, pinned updates template
- [ ] Notify Customer Success about maintenance window (template below)

Backports / critical PRs to include:
- PR #789 - hotfix: kv-cache serialization (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/789) - must land and be smoke-tested
- PR #801 - backport metrics fix to release branch (owner: Mateo)
- PROJ-4821 - DB migration for rollout flags (blocker until schema tested)

Rollback plan (if anything > severity-2):
- Step 1: Pause traffic routing, shift to previous model variant pool (Aisha)
- Step 2: Revert last deploy using tag v2026-03-06-stable (release-engineering)
- Step 3: Restore DB snapshot from pre-cutover (SRE) - expect ~20-30m RTO
- Step 4: Notify stakeholders and open postmortem ticket (owner: Mateo)

Monitoring / verification (quick list):
- Grafana dashboards: cutover-dash (latency, error-rate, token-per-sec)
- Logs: search for 5xx spikes, OOMs in workers
- Traces: sample slow requests (>2s) in Jaeger
- Business metrics: API key auth success, billing events, embedding throughput

Comms templates (post to #release-cutover and external):
- Quick status update (internal): "09:00 CUTOVER START - DB migration started. Canary deploy in progress. No user-facing impact observed so far. Mateo leading."
- External (CS template): "Planned maintenance window: 09:00-11:00 PST. We are deploying improvements with expected no downtime; will provide updates at 09:30 and 10:30."

Open/risks and notes to self:
- Blocker: PROJ-4821 migration edge case on older customer accounts - verify on 2 test tenants before 09:00
- Risk: rabbitmq queue lag under increased traffic; have SRE ready to throttle producers
- Note: remember to remove debug logging from model-runner after smoke tests
- TODO: update runbook with schema v42 rollback commands (I owe this to SRE)

Post-cutover immediate tasks (first 2 hours):
- [ ] Run full integration test suite against main
- [ ] Confirm metrics ingestion for new telemetry keys
- [ ] Close any temporary kill-switch toggles and update console feature flags
- [ ] Send final cutover summary to #eng-updates and cs-ops@redwood.com

Owners / contacts:
- Release lead: Mateo Chen (pager: +1-555-0107)
- SRE: Riley Park (pager: +1-555-0123)
- Infra: Aisha Patel
- QA: Jordan Lee

Notes to self: keep updates terse. If something goes wrong, call the on-call and move to rollback quickly. Save all logs and timestamp steps.

Linked tickets / refs: PROJ-4821, PROJ-4875, PRs: #789, #801. Confluence runbook: https://confluence.internal.redwood/release/2026-03-cutover

Last-minute checklist before clicking deploy:
- [ ] confirm db backups
- [ ] confirm canary traffic policy applied
- [ ] double-check feature-flag defaults
- [ ] ensure team is watching Slack + PagerDuty

-- end scratchpad --
